name: md2epub
description: Convert a folder of Markdown into a reflowable EPUB 3.

scripts.build: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git -C ../.. log -1 --format=%ct) node bin/md2epub.js ../.. --each -o ../../dist/books -a hiepgithub2001 --mermaid render/mermaid.js
scripts.build:one: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git -C ../.. log -1 --format=%ct) node bin/md2epub.js ../.. -o ../../dist/swedocs.epub -t 'swedocs — Software Knowledge Base' -a hiepgithub2001 --mermaid render/mermaid.js
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && npm run validate --silent
